title: WEAVE: Weaving Real-World Code Evolution into Dependency-Structured Tasks for Benchmarking and Training Code Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.22039v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Real-world software engineering rarely consists of isolated changes. Features, migrations, and systematic fixes often unfold across multiple pull requests (PRs), requiring coordinated modifications across a repository. Yet most executable repository-level benchmarks retain a single issue or PR as the task unit, while existing multi-PR settings rely on coarse aggregation and structure-agnostic evaluation. This mismatch obscures dependencies among changes and limits progress measurement and learning signals for long-horizon code agents. We introduce WEAVE, a framework that transforms verified PR histories into executable, dependency-structured tasks. WEAVE leverages repository-calibrated typed change loci to organize related PRs into bounded DAGs and instantiate each as a unified executable task. translated_title: WEAVE：将真实世界代码演进编织为依赖结构化任务，用于代码智能体的基准测试与训练
translated_abstract: 真实世界的软件工程很少由孤立的变更构成。功能开发、迁移和系统性修复往往跨越多个拉取请求（PR）展开，需要对整个代码库进行协调一致的修改。然而，大多数可执行的代码库级基准测试仍以单个 issue 或 PR 作为任务单元，而现有的多 PR 设置则依赖粗粒度的聚合和与结构无关的评估。这种错位掩盖了变更之间的依赖关系，限制了长程代码智能体的进展衡量和学习信号。我们提出了 WEAVE，一个将经过验证的 PR 历史转化为可执行的、依赖结构化任务的框架。WEAVE 利用代码库校准的类型化变更位点，将相关联的 PR 组织成有界 DAG（有向无环图），并将每个 DAG 实例化为统一的可执行任务。我们进一步引入了 Graph Credit，这是一种确定性的、基于测试的度量指标，用于衡量符合依赖关系的部分进展，并支持更密集的……
tldr: WEAVE 框架将真实世界中经过验证的多 PR 代码演进历史转化为依赖结构化的可执行任务，并引入基于测试的确定性度量 Graph Credit，以更好地对长程代码智能体进行基准评估和训练。
en_tdlr: WEAVE transforms verified real-world multi-PR code evolution histories into executable dependency-structured tasks, and introduces Graph Credit, a deterministic test-grounded metric, to enable better benchmarking and training of long-horizon code agents.
